name: The Order
description: Out to avenge his mother's death, a college student pledges a secret order and lands in a war between werewolves and practitioners of dark magic.

videos.title: Hell Week (1)
videos.overview: At Belgrave University, Jack pledges a secret society steeped in mystery and magic. Soon, a series of strange murders sets the campus on edge.

videos.title: Hell Week (2)
videos.overview: Pops shares a theory about the attacks. Jack and Alyssa try to keep an eye on the other pledges. At the Temple, Jack encounters a notorious figure.

videos.title: Introduction to Ethics (1)
videos.overview: Jack learns he's been selected for a rival secret society. Later, he gets a lesson in magic -- and discovers that every spell has a price.

videos.title: Introduction to Ethics (2)
videos.overview: Jack proposes an alliance with the Knights, and Randall teaches him how to harness his powers. Meanwhile, Edward takes Alyssa under his wing.

videos.title: Homecoming (1)
videos.overview: As the Order prepares to conduct a dangerous, sinister spell, the Knights enlist Jack to sabotage their plans.

videos.title: Homecoming (2)
videos.overview: While the Order hunts for werewolves on campus, Jack and Alyssa flee with Renee's necrophone, a tool used to communicate with the dead.

videos.title: Undeclared (1)
videos.overview: Alyssa confronts Jack about his secret. Headmistress Vera questions Edward about the Vade Maecum and sends Gabrielle on a truth-seeking mission.

videos.title: Undeclared (2)
videos.overview: Alyssa helps the Knights search for Randall and stumbles upon a doctor's twisted experiment. Edward is visited by the Vade Maecum's previous owner.

videos.title: Finals (1)
videos.overview: Consumed by ambition, Edward clashes with Vera -- and Alyssa is caught in the middle. Jack's brush with the Vade Maecum ignites a painful ordeal.

videos.title: Finals (2)
videos.overview: The Knights plot to thwart Edward's plan by kidnapping his son. Gabrielle and the Hermetic Counselor interrogate Lilith.

videos.title: Free Radicals (1)
videos.overview: After having the Knights' memories wiped, Vera plans to induct them into the Order. But her new pledges prove hard to control.

videos.title: Free Radicals (2)
videos.overview: While the Knights look for ways to protect themselves, Alyssa gives Jack a job: find the "magic tourist" who's been wreaking havoc on campus.

videos.title: Fear Itself (1)
videos.overview: The Knights raid the Order’s magic vault, Alyssa confides in Randall about her fading powers, and romance blooms between Lilith and Nicole.

videos.title: Fear Itself (2)
videos.overview: Vera leads the Order in a spell to summon Rogwan, a powerful demon. But when her plan goes awry, she needs the Knights on her side.

videos.title: The Commons (1)
videos.overview: Vera negotiates a deal with the Sons of Prometheus — a rival magic society — and sends Jack and Alyssa to their compound as hostages.

videos.title: The Commons (2)
videos.overview: Amid a standoff with the Prometheans, Alyssa goes into withdrawal. Meanwhile, Randall, Hamish and Gabrielle track professor Foley.

videos.title: Spring Outbreak (1)
videos.overview: The Knights weigh whether to join the Order. Alyssa suspects that her feelings for Jack might be blocking her magic. Kepler pulls rank on Vera.

videos.title: Spring Outbreak (2)
videos.overview: The Knights try to prevent a strange affliction from spreading. Kepler schemes to strip Vera of her power, and Alyssa searches Vera's house.

videos.title: New World Order (1)
videos.overview: Nicole finds a spell that could bring back Lilith, but it hinges on Alyssa’s cooperation. Jack tries to broker a deal between Vera and Salvador.

videos.title: New World Order (2)
videos.overview: As chaos reigns, the Knights must convince Vera and Alyssa to work together to seal the eruption and save Lilith from the demon realm.
